text: ごきげんよう　まあ　それは　あなたが　つかまえて　くださった　＊ね！

structure.jp: あなたが　つかまえて　くださった　＊ね！
structure.en: the ＊ you kindly caught for me, isn't it!

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.span: つかまえて　くださった
patterns.explanation: くださる after a て-verb is the respectful form of くれる: someone kindly does it for me. つかまえて　くださった = 'you kindly caught it for me'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あなたが　つかまえて　くださった　＊
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb, placed right before a thing, describes that thing. あなたが　つかまえて　くださった　＊ = 'the ＊ that you caught for me'.
